name: 12027 · Burnt Hills, NY
findings: ZIP 12027 (Burnt Hills) has 18 nonprofit organizations. 12 of them (67%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 9 organizations.
Education organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (44% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 12027 (Burnt Hills) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
25% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 12027 (Burnt Hills) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 3.1 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 9 organizations here; 44% of all organizations here have no identified type.
